evidence: Skill procedure for check 7: 'ask what the smallest submission satisfying the brief would be'; defect is 'a static page, a single CRUD screen, or a mock satisfies the ask'. The brief asks for a from-scratch build: task/instruction.md 'there is no starter app to finish' and seed_data.json has '"snippets": []' with no implementation, so no trivial tweak is possible. The ask itself is substantial: ui.md 'Build the code editing surface with your own DOM, canvas or SVG text model. Don't use a textarea, input or contenteditable element ... and don't use CodeMirror, Monaco, Ace ...', plus multi-caret editing, undo grouping, find/replace, token colouring and formatting; behaviour.md requires isolated Run with a five-second budget, last-good restore, Stop, stale-save refusal, live library refresh and idempotent restore; integration.md requires SQLite persistence across 'complete process restarts'. The reference is about 2,160 authored lines (custom-editor.js 1284, runtime.ts 408, app.tsx 176, server.js 171). The verifier enforces this rather than only stating it: (1) render gate cw_workspace_loads_and_takes_typing fails 'a static shell whose editor cannot be typed into'; (2) constraints gate (aggregation all_pass) cw_custom_document_surface fails when 'the displayed source text lives in a textarea, an input or an element with contenteditable enabled, including a transparent one layered over a highlighted copy' or carries a ready-made editor's root markers, and cw_shared_saved_record requires the saved snippet to be found, with exact title, filename and source, after origin storage is cleared and the page reloaded, so a browser-only mock fails; (3) tests/scoring.toml '[floors] functional = 0.05' with score.py 'floors_passed = scored_ran and all(scores[k] > f ...)' and 'reward = ... if gates_passed and floors_passed else 0.0', so nothing is paid for looks alone; (4) functional carries 0.6 of the reward over 42 behavioural criteria totalling weight 58.5, each driven with real keys and mouse and each a conjunction with a positive control. Stub attempts I walked through: nop or static page gives 0 (render gate); a textarea or contenteditable playground, or one wrapping CodeMirror/Monaco, gives 0 (constraints gate); a custom surface that saves only to localStorage gives 0 (constraints gate); a custom surface with server save but nothing else working gives 0 (functional floor, strict greater-than 0.05 means more than 2.925 weight, i.e. at least three criteria). Conforming alternative: canvas or SVG editors, any layout, labels, routes and schema are accepted ('Passes when the source is drawn by ordinary non-editable elements, canvas or SVG'), so a real build in a different style is not excluded. Measured support is partial only: scripted golden results on these bytes show all 3 gate, 42 functional and 6 polish checks true; the hosted run was on an EARLIER candidate (nop 0, Oracle 0.9833, GPT-5.6 Luna 0 on the render gate) and is not a measurement of these bytes. Residual risk, not a defect: the thinnest app that earns anything is a self-built editor with typing, Backspace/Delete joins and keyboard Undo, a server-backed Save, a working Run and HTML preview, and tidy styling. By my arithmetic (not measured) that passes roughly 4 of 58.5 functional weight (about 0.07, worth 0.04), perhaps 4 to 5 of 6 polish criteria and a high visual rating, for a reward near 0.35 to 0.4, because polish and visual together hold 0.4 of the weight and are gated only by the 5 percent floor. That app is still real build work, not a stub, a single CRUD screen or a mock, and the 0.6/0.2/0.2 split and floor are template policy, so I do not report it as a Fail; but no judge run on these bytes, and no thin-app discrimination run, has measured where such an app actually lands, so risk stays true.
